approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency and accuracy across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce ordinary and cross-source answers whose explicit numbers disagree with their exact quotations.
Fail closed on unsupported numeric literals without inferring arithmetic, conversions or semantic authority.
Reuse a settled question across repeated-whitespace variants without changing the submitted prompt or collapsing case-sensitive identifiers.
Preserve exact recovery for settled tasks created before cache normalization and validate with synthetic offline evidence only.
title: Ground numeric answers and reuse equivalent question tasks
objective: Reject explicit numbers absent from their own project-file evidence and avoid duplicate paid questions caused only by repeated whitespace.
